name: Ecuador Mushroom Grow Kit
description:
Ecuador cubensis grow kit | Best shroom grow kits

Ecuador cubensis grow kit. This Psilocybe cubensis Ecuador could be called the mountain settler within the family of magic mushrooms.

To begin with It is best to withstand not so perfect conditions (particularly temperatures lower than 20°C) during fructification – but that’s not really a miracle, for it originates from the Ecuadorian Andean region and it can get pretty chilly up there. Author’s note (known from personal experience). This is a some what special variety of magic mushrooms, for it can make you feel as if you were running a mental marathon – the effect has a speedy facet, accelerating your train of thought to such a high pace, that makes it hard to get a grip on a thought before it vanished behind a squall of new ones chasing it downhill.

Magic mushroom grow kits by Fresh Mushrooms contains 1200ml of colonized substrate (rye) and is ready to grow when it arrives at your doorstep.

Ecuador mushroom grow kit scope of delivery:

• 1200ml cultivation box

• Grow bag

• 2 Paper clips
